name: shravan-dev-workflow
description: Shravan's development workflow plugin with long-horizon delivery routing, bounded design orchestration, canonical planning, implementation and independent review, research, handoffs, PR lifecycle, debugging, operations, skill authoring, agent management, and structured TUI presentation.

interface.shortDescription: Spec/program design, review, planning, implementation, operations, agents, and TUI workflows
interface.longDescription: Use Shravan Dev Workflow to route a long-horizon delivery goal through proven phase gates, run one bounded design cycle, translate reviewed design into one canonical ready plan with delivery intent, execute it without a generic post-plan approval gate, independently review implementation and proof, and finish PR readiness without merging. The plugin also gathers source-grounded evidence, packages handoffs, investigates bugs, routes operations work, authors skills, maintains docs, and structures TUI explanations.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a plan handoff.
Prepare an implementation handoff.
Use spec-design to preserve separate Requirements and Specification identities: authorized Why and observable What.
Use program-design to define structural How against this specification.
Use discuss-clarify-mental-models to rebuild the shared map before artifact work.
Use discuss-pathfinding to extract unwritten requirements or decisions before artifact work.
Use research-swarm to gather source-grounded evidence into a tmp ledger.
Use manage-agents to spawn, resume, monitor, or reduce subordinate agent work.
Use orchestrator-design to run this through one bounded Requirements, Specification, Program Design, and three-artifact design review cycle before planning.
Use orchestrator-goal to route this long-horizon delivery goal from its first unproven gate to PR readiness without duplicating phase judgment or merging.
Use plan-implementation to create one repo-grounded proof-bearing plan from this reviewed design set.
Use implement-plan to execute this ready canonical plan at its immutable path, current meaning, and pr-ready-unmerged delivery context.
Use review-implementation to independently review this implementation and proof without editing.
Use docs-maintain to reconcile these docs with current code and plans.
Use spec-program-review to independently review this Specification, this Program Design, or this complete Requirements, Specification, and Program Design set.
Use spec-handoff to package this design for another agent.
Use plan-improve-repo to audit this repo and write executable improvement plans.
Use ops-security-review to choose the right Codex Security scan.
Use ops-observability-stack to prove local logs, metrics, and traces through the shared stack.
Use implementation-pr-wrapup to finish this PR.
Investigate this bug before fixing it.
Use skills-creation to create, update, or evaluate one named skill.
Audit these skills against session evidence.
